parameters.name: GlobalAccelerationInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the shared-bandwidth GA instance.

parameters.name: IpInstanceId
parameters.description:
The EIP ID. You can call the [DescribeEipAddresses](~~36018~~) operation to query EIP IDs.

>  Make sure that the billing method of the EIP is pay-as-you-go, and the EIP and the shared-bandwidth GA instance belong to the same region.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region of the shared-bandwidth GA instance.

You can call the **DescribeRegions** operation to query the most recent region list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc add-global-acceleration-instance-ip --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --global-acceleration-instance-id ga-Ldefrgbttnyyf0000 --ip-instance-id eip-rw434rwfdeaf0000 --region cn-hangzhou
